high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent longitudinal shadow-casting ridge is visible along the central posterior axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, high-contrast dark oval blowhole located at the anterior dorsal position.
